summary: Your tenth Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on chunking, the retrieval pipeline, filters and the search endpoint with a confidence number, extend your glossary, run the whole system from cold, tag week 10 and plan week 11.
goal: Explain chunking and retrieval in your own words, start the system from cold, and plan week 11.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Glossary: add 7 new words with a one-line definition and an example from your assistant
Run it from cold: down, up, ingest, API and one search using only your README
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Run git tag week-10 and see tag: week-10 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 11: one outcome sentence, 7 sessions in your calendar, a drop list, and start the database
Play the Week 10 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
